title: James Bond Shocker: Robert Pattinson and Nicholas Hoult Late Contenders for 007 After Auditioning for Denis Villeneuve
content:
ByAngelique Jackson

AsJames Bondcasting rumors heat up, a couple more A-list actors have entered the mix:Robert PattinsonandNicholas Houltwere among the stars who screen-tested to play the new 007.

Both British actors certainly have the acting pedigree to play the suave spy, taking up the mantle after Daniel Craig’s 15-year run. They also have a keen awareness of what it takes to work in major franchise fare: Pattinson stars as Batman for DC Studios and is an alum of both the “Twilight” and “Harry Potter” franchises; meanwhile, Hoult plays Lex Luthor in DC’s Superman movies and starred in the 2010s “X-Men” prequel trilogy. Pattinson also has the Denis Villeneuve factor on his side, after starring in the filmmaker’s upcoming epic “Dune: Part Three.”

Last year,Amazon MGM Studiostapped Villeneuve as the franchise’s next director, with “Peaky Blinders” creator Steven Knight hired to write the script. Getting Bond 26 off the ground has been a top priority for the property’s new stewards, producers Amy Pascal and David Heyman.

Since then, nearly every 30-something British actor’s name has been bandied about in the U.K. and U.S. press, with rumored top contenders including Callum Turner, Josh O’Connor and Jack Lowden.Varietyhas learned that Harry Styles has had discussions about the part, and Theo James also hasn’t been ruled out.

Pierce Brosnan, the Bond of the 90s, recently gave his stamp of approval to Turner, while Gary Oldman threw his weight behind Lowden, his “Slow Horses” co-star. (Oldman also claimed that the next James Bond has already been picked, but no official casting announcement has been made.)

Amazon declined to comment on the casting rumors.
title_zh: 詹姆斯·邦德驚爆消息：羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)和尼古拉斯·霍爾特(Nicholas Hoult)在為丹尼斯·維倫紐瓦(Denis Villeneuve)試鏡後，成為007的晚期競爭者。
content_zh:
由安潔莉克·傑克森(Angelique Jackson)報導

隨著詹姆斯·邦德(James Bond)的選角傳聞愈演愈烈，幾位A級演員也加入了競爭行列：羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)和尼古拉斯·霍爾特(Nicholas Hoult)是參加新007試鏡的明星之一。

這兩位英國演員無疑具備演技背景，能夠勝任這位優雅間諜的角色，接替丹尼爾·克雷格(Daniel Craig)15年的演出。他們也非常清楚在大型特許經營作品中工作的要求：帕丁森在DC Studios中飾演蝙蝠俠(Batman)，並且是《暮光之城》(Twilight)和《哈利·波特》(Harry Potter)系列的校友；而霍爾特則在DC的超人(Superman)電影中飾演萊克斯·盧瑟(Lex Luthor)，並在2010年代的《X戰警》(X-Men)前傳三部曲中主演。帕丁森還因主演導演丹尼斯·維倫紐瓦(Denis Villeneuve)即將上映的史詩巨作《沙丘：第三部》(Dune: Part Three)而擁有額外的優勢。

去年，亞馬遜MGM Studios將維倫紐瓦任命為該系列的下一任導演，並聘請《黑道家族》(Peaky Blinders)創作者史蒂文·奈特(Steven Knight)撰寫劇本。對於這部《邦德26》(Bond 26)的啟動，製作人艾米·帕斯卡(Amy Pascal)和大衛·海曼(David Heyman)將其視為首要任務。

自那時以來，幾乎每位30多歲的英國演員的名字都在英國和美國媒體中被提及，傳聞中的熱門競爭者包括卡倫·特納(Callum Turner)、喬什·奧康納(Josh O’Connor)和傑克·洛登(Jack Lowden)。據《綜藝》(Variety)報導，哈利·史泰爾斯(Harry Styles)已經就這個角色進行過討論，而西奧·詹姆斯(Theo James)也未被排除在外。

90年代的邦德皮爾斯·布洛斯南(Pierce Brosnan)最近對特納表示支持，而加里·奧德曼(Gary Oldman)則支持他的《慢馬》(Slow Horses)共演者洛登。(奧德曼還聲稱下一任詹姆斯·邦德已經選定，但尚未有官方的選角公告。)

亞馬遜對於選角傳聞拒絕評論。
summary_zh:
由安潔莉克·傑克森(Angelique Jackson)報導

隨著詹姆斯·邦德(James Bond)的選角傳聞愈演愈烈，幾位A級演員也加入了競爭行列：羅伯特·帕丁森(Robert Pattinson)和尼古拉斯·霍爾特(Nicholas Hoult)是參加新007試鏡的明星之一。
